Summary: <USER_CONTEXT>
Fix global-buffer-overflow in libxml2's xmlDictHashName/xmlDictLookupInternal (OSS-Fuzz issue 42531092, testcase 6558959062089728). Crash: Global-buffer-overflow READ 1 in xmlDictLookupInternal → xmlDictLookupHashed → xmlParseNCName. The OOB read occurs before the global table xmlIsPubidChar_tab.

COMPLETED:
- Identified repository state: HEAD is commit 8f1e2a1 "Fix global-buffer-overflow in xmlDictHashName" (fix commit), parent is 3c9b7d2 "Initial commit" (vulnerable version)
- Confirmed /workspace/_work/src is identical to /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul (no diff in dict.c or parser.c)
- Retrieved OSS-Fuzz issue details confirming crash type, stack trace, and testcase ID
- Downloaded testcase to /workspace/testcase (207 bytes)
- Analyzed testcase content via od: bytes 0-3 are 4 spaces, bytes 4-12 are binary `\x00\x00\x8b\x41\x5c\x0a\x00\x00\x00`, byte 13 is `<`, bytes 14-206 are 193 spaces
- Examined xmlParseNCName and xmlParseNCNameComplex functions in parser.c (lines 3475-3573)
- Examined xmlParseQNameHashed function (lines 8797-8830) and its callers at lines 8858, 9145, 9369
- Traced the flow: after `<`, spaces cause xmlParseNCName to return NULL; xmlParseQNameHashed returns NULL when CUR != ':'

PENDING:
- Understand the exact trigger mechanism for the OOB read (the trace so far doesn't show how the crash occurs with spaces after `<`)
- Determine the root cause in xmlDictHashName/xmlDictLookupInternal
- Implement the fix (likely in dict.c or parser.c)
- Verify the fix resolves the issue

CURRENT_STATE:
- Working directory: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul
- Git HEAD: 8f1e2a1 (fix commit), parent: 3c9b7d2 (vulnerable)
- Crash stack: xmlDictLookupInternal → xmlDictLookupHashed → xmlParseNCName
- Crash type: Global-buffer-overflow READ 1, address 0x0000008d6b81
- OOB read is "before the global table xmlIsPubidChar_tab"
- Testcase downloaded and analyzed at /workspace/testcase

CODE_STATE:
- Files of interest: dict.c (xmlDictHashName, xmlDictLookupInternal, xmlDictLookupHashed), parser.c (xmlParseNCName, xmlParseNCNameComplex, xmlParseQNameHashed)
- xmlIsPubidChar_tab defined in include/libxml/chvalid.h:191
- IS_PUBIDCHAR macros in include/libxml/parserInternals.h:279,287
- xmlParseNCNameComplex at parser.c:3475, xmlParseNCName at parser.c:3530
- xmlParseQNameHashed at parser.c:8797, called at lines 8858, 9145, 9369
- The fix commit 8f1e2a1 exists in git history but its diff hasn't been fully examined yet

TESTS:
- OSS-Fuzz testcase ID: 6558959062089728
- Crash: Global-buffer-overflow READ 1 in xmlDictLookupInternal
- Crash address: 0x0000008d6b81
- Testcase content: 4 spaces + binary data + `<` + 193 spaces (207 bytes total)

CHANGES:
- No code changes made yet
- Testcase downloaded and analyzed

DEPS:
- libxml2 source code
- od for hex dump (xxd not available)

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS:
- Branch: master
- HEAD: 8f1e2a1 "Fix global-buffer-overflow in xmlDictHashName"
- Parent: 3c9b7d2 "Initial commit"
- Working tree clean
